Sir Anthony Hopkins Uses Google Maps to Revisit His Welsh Childhood Streets

2026-08-21 BBC News Google Maps, Anthony Hopkins, Wales, Port Talbot, Street View, nostalgia, digital memory, celebrity
Read the source article

Quick summary

Oscar-winning actor Sir Anthony Hopkins, 88, says he uses Google Maps virtually every day to revisit the streets of his childhood in Port Talbot, Wales, inspiring his first music album released at age 88.

Key takeaways

  • Sir Anthony Hopkins, 88, uses Google Maps to virtually walk the streets of his childhood in Port Talbot, Wales
  • He describes going to streets and moving up the street using photographs on Google Maps "most days"
  • The actor says he's "a bit too old" to physically return to walk the streets but finds solace in the digital exploration
  • His childhood memories on Bracken Road in Port Talbot inspired a musical composition on his debut album
  • Hopkins describes Wales as "the land of hiraeth (longing)" and credits it as the source of his identity
  • He released his first album at 88, comprising music he has written over more than 60 years
